title: 💼 Professional work
summary: The techniques I use at work, applied to invented data from a clinic network and a farm co-op. Every project runs, and its tests prove it does what the write-up says.

projects.title: Clinic capacity planning: fill targets, glide paths & outreach sizing
projects.summary: A planning product for a clinic network's screening sessions: it turns appointment pace into targets, projections and gap-to-target, then sizes the outreach needed to close the gap, with a config-driven pipeline, SQL layer, notebook and live dashboard.
projects.tools: Python (pandas, NumPy), SQL (Snowflake dialect), YAML config, pytest, Jupyter, JavaScript (SVG)

projects.title: Dashboard gallery: seven interactive dashboards and the logic behind them
projects.summary: Re-creations of the kinds of dashboards I build for planning, pricing and operations teams, on invented clinic-network and farm co-op data. Every number is computed by tested Python, and every page is interactive.
projects.tools: Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy), statistics (holdout tests, Poisson models), JavaScript, SVG, Playwright, pytest

projects.title: Data knowledge assistant: catalog, glossary, lineage & grounded Q&A
projects.summary: A self-service assistant for a clinic network's appointment-planning data. It answers "what is this view, where does this column live, what feeds what, what does this term mean?" from a validated catalog, with sources for every answer, as a static web app and a Python package.
projects.tools: Python (PyYAML, networkx), information retrieval (BM25), JavaScript, GitHub Pages, Playwright, pytest

projects.title: Market price intelligence: product matching, feed monitoring & price index
projects.summary: A pipeline that tells a farm co-op where its prices sit against competing suppliers: it matches their listings to the co-op's lots, cleans a daily price feed with every common defect planted, and computes a price index that only uses data it can trust.
projects.tools: Python (pandas, SciPy assignment, difflib), pytest

projects.title: Buyer-order reconciliation & substitution bids (farm co-op)
projects.summary: Daily and weekly reconciliation between a buyer marketplace and a farm co-op's invoicing system, plus an optimizer that decides which grade-substitution bids to accept. Runnable, tested, with an Excel exception report.
projects.tools: Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy MILP), Excel automation (openpyxl, XlsxWriter), pytest

projects.title: Produce pricing: elasticity, constrained price optimization & handover
projects.summary: A pricing model for a farm co-op: estimates how price-sensitive each market segment and produce grade is, recommends prices within harvest volume, guardrails and a grade ladder, and comes with plain-SQL validation checks for whoever runs it next.
projects.tools: Python (pandas, NumPy), regression (log-log OLS, empirical-Bayes shrinkage), optimization, SQL, pytest

projects.title: SQL performance tuning: measured, explained and checked for correctness
projects.summary: A benchmark on 1M clinic appointments and 2.5M status events: five slow-query patterns, each with query plans before and after, timings, and a check that the results didn't change, except where the old query was wrong.
projects.tools: SQL (SQLite here; the same patterns apply to Snowflake and Oracle), query plans (EXPLAIN), indexing, Python, pytest

projects.title: Legacy report migration kit: Oracle → Snowflake translator, column audit & parity harness
projects.summary: Tools for moving a clinic network's legacy Oracle reports onto a modern warehouse: a rule-based SQL translator that logs every change, an output-column audit that finds the cause of "merged" columns, a parity harness that explains every difference, and a migration-wave planner.
projects.tools: SQL (Oracle, Snowflake, SQLite), Python (pandas), pytest

projects.title: Clinic data warehouse: layers, lineage, linting & data contracts
projects.summary: A working mini-warehouse for a clinic network's appointment data: SQL models built in dependency order, a convention linter, data contracts and generated documentation, so everyone can see what feeds what and broken data can't reach a report quietly.
projects.tools: SQL (SQLite here, written to port to Snowflake), Python (networkx, matplotlib), pytest, data modelling, data governance

title: 📐 Analytical methods
summary: The analysis techniques behind my projects (clustering, historical and velocity analysis, scatter and regression, statistics and quality control, optimisation) with the maths, the formulas, and tested code.

projects.title: Cluster analysis: finding booking-behaviour segments
projects.summary: Scaling, distance measures, k-means++, choosing k (elbow, silhouette, gap), Ward hierarchy, PCA, validation and segment profiling, written from scratch in NumPy and checked against four segments planted in synthetic clinic data.
projects.tools: Python (NumPy, pandas, matplotlib; SciPy only to draw the dendrogram), pytest (SciPy and scikit-learn as independent cross-checks)

projects.title: Historical comparisons & order velocity: reading demand against its own past
projects.summary: Weekday-aligned YoY, rolling sums, lead-time velocity curves, pace projections with intervals, classical decomposition, forecasting baselines with a rolling-origin backtest, CUSUM change detection and cohort triangles, written from scratch in NumPy/pandas and checked against planted structure.
projects.tools: Python (NumPy, pandas, matplotlib), pytest

projects.title: Optimisation & decision maths: from linear programs to expected value
projects.summary: A from-scratch toolkit for planning and decision problems: simplex with shadow prices and sensitivity ranges, transportation, knapsack and branch-and-bound, the Hungarian algorithm, Newton and golden-section pricing, Lagrange budget splits, decision trees, EVPI and the newsvendor rule, each checked against brute force, closed forms or SciPy.
projects.tools: Python (NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib), SciPy (as an independent check in tests only), pytest

projects.title: Scatter, correlation & regression: reading relationships honestly
projects.summary: Correlation, OLS with full inference, log-log elasticity, diagnostics, confounding and robust fits, written from scratch in NumPy and tested against data where the true relationships are known.
projects.tools: Python (NumPy, pandas, SciPy for the t / χ² distributions, matplotlib), pytest

projects.title: Statistics & quality control: from a confidence interval to a control chart
projects.summary: A from-scratch toolkit for everyday statistics and process quality: descriptive stats and the core distributions, confidence intervals and tests, control charts with CUSUM and EWMA, capability indices, Pareto/ABC and Gini, queueing formulas checked by simulation, and Monte Carlo with tornado sensitivity, each validated against hand calculations, closed forms or SciPy.
projects.tools: Python (NumPy, pandas, Matplotlib), SciPy (probability tables, and as an independent check in tests), pytest

title: 🚀 Recent work
summary: What I've been building lately — written up as case studies, since the source code for these lives in private repositories.

projects.title: Reproducible developer environment
projects.summary: A version-controlled setup that rebuilds a full development machine — packages, runtimes, editor and shell — from a few files.
projects.tools: Homebrew (Brewfile), conda, zsh, VS Code, Git, shell scripting

projects.title: Keyless Google Cloud access from GitHub Actions
projects.summary: Replaced a long-lived service-account key stored in CI with short-lived, keyless credentials (Workload Identity Federation).
projects.tools: GitHub Actions (OIDC), Google Cloud IAM, Workload Identity Federation, Python (google-auth)

projects.title: Media library & catalog app
projects.summary: A full-stack app for cataloging books, manga and anime: shared catalog, personal shelves, barcode scanning and admin import tools.
projects.tools: React 18, React Router, Vite, Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions), SQL, GitHub Actions

title: 📊 Data analysis & BI
summary: Tableau dashboards, clustering, forecasting and text mining on real-world and sample datasets.

projects.title: How does a country's quality of life affect mortality?
projects.summary: Interactive Tableau story on the cost of a healthy diet, food affordability, GDP and mortality around the world.
projects.tools: Tableau (dashboards, maps, forecasting), data blending

projects.title: Google Play app segmentation & marketing strategy
projects.summary: Clustered Google Play Store apps by rating, reviews, installs and price, then built a marketing budget plan per segment.
projects.tools: R (tidyverse, cluster), K-means, hierarchical clustering

projects.title: Home health care providers
projects.summary: Mapped and summarized home-health providers and patient volumes from a public U.S. survey dataset.
projects.tools: Tableau (maps, aggregation)

projects.title: Hospital revenue & procedure analysis
projects.summary: Table calculations, cohorts, rankings and a what-if parameter on hospital revenue data.
projects.tools: Tableau (table calculations, LOD-style dimensions, parameters)

projects.title: Predictive models & market-basket analysis in RapidMiner
projects.summary: Classification and association-rule models built as visual RapidMiner workflows.
projects.tools: RapidMiner Studio (decision trees, linear discriminant analysis, FP-Growth, association rules)

projects.title: Text mining in RapidMiner
projects.summary: Turned unstructured text — reviews, support messages and historical essays — into clusters, keywords and themes.
projects.tools: RapidMiner Studio (tokenizing, stemming, TF-IDF, n-grams, K-means, FP-Growth, PCA)

projects.title: Superstore sales: forecasting, trend lines & clustering
projects.summary: Forecasted sales, fitted regression trend lines and clustered customers by profit and sales.
projects.tools: Tableau (forecasting, clustering, regression)

title: 💹 Economics & finance
summary: Finance, economics and pricing methods as tested code: a formula toolkit, credit vintage curves, marketing ROI, overbooking economics and a ledger lab.

projects.title: Blockchain ledger vs database: a settlement data-management lab
projects.summary: A from-scratch hash-linked ledger (Merkle trees, proof of work, a permissioned signer set, UTXO and account models, off-chain documents) run on the same settlement workload as a SQLite database, so tamper evidence, storage, speed and erasure can be compared with real numbers.
projects.tools: Python (hashlib, sqlite3, pandas, NumPy, matplotlib), SQL, graph cycle detection, pytest

projects.title: Finance & demand-analytics formula toolkit
projects.summary: 40 finance, economics and demand-analytics formulas, including NPV/IRR, amortisation, elasticities, curve normalisation, gross vs net targets and credibility weighting, as a tested Python package with an in-browser calculator.
projects.tools: Python, pytest, JavaScript, Playwright

projects.title: Loan vintage curves: reference bands, credibility projection & loss vs plan
projects.summary: Vintage analysis for a synthetic consumer-loan book: cumulative default curves by months on book, seasoned reference bands, lifetime projections that blend each vintage's own pace with the reference by Bühlmann credibility, and a back-test of how well that works.
projects.tools: Python (pandas, NumPy, matplotlib), survival/hazard simulation, chain ladder, Bühlmann-Straub credibility, pytest

projects.title: Marketing budget allocation & ROI: response curves, optimal split, NPV and A/B test design
projects.summary: Fits media response curves to weekly sales, splits a $500k digital budget so every channel earns the same marginal return, prices the plan (NPV, IRR, payback, ROI range from 5,000 simulations) and sizes the A/B tests that check it.
projects.tools: Python (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, matplotlib), nonlinear least squares, constrained optimisation (SLSQP, KKT check), discounted cash flow, Monte Carlo simulation, power analysis, pytest

projects.title: Overbooking economics: how many patients to book into a session
projects.summary: Exact expected profit for every booking limit when patients may not show, three ways to find the best limit (they agree), show-rate estimation with empirical-Bayes shrinkage, a Monte Carlo check, and an interactive calculator that runs the same maths in the browser.
projects.tools: Python (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, matplotlib), probability (binomial, beta-binomial, Poisson), empirical Bayes, Monte Carlo, JavaScript (SVG), Playwright, pytest
